subject: /usr/sbin/soapc
invocation_format: /usr/sbin/soapc <eventIndex>  (single integer argv, range 1000..9998; usage string: 'Usage: soapc <eventIndex>')

central_launcher.guard_string: same soapc %s is running, ignore this call!!
central_launcher.logic: check_set_soapc guards against concurrent duplicate invocations; hook_soapc spawns /usr/sbin/soapc with event id; check_soapc_index_running polls via ps.

callers.notes: sets nvram soapc_sat_router_fire=6 or 7 to request sync (comment: 'Notify Satellites to sync')

callers.role: watchdog — kills stuck or over-count soapc processes
evidence_strings: [acos_wd] soapc number is more then 15, killall first

callers.role: service lifecycle: starts abFifo for soapc log, resets soapc running flag
firmware upgrade coordinator — reads soapc sat response NVRAM to decide upgrade
callers.notes: check_fw is the only master-side reader of the string soapc_pass. soapc itself does not read or write soapc_pass. Paste warning stands: existence of the string does not prove the nvram key is populated.

callers.role: attached-device tracker — merges satellite-side device lists into master
callers.signal_received: SIGUSR2 — soapc sends 'killall -SIGUSR2 device_detect' after NVRAM updates to prompt re-read

callers.role: schedule-action engine — triggers wifi fire via nvram

log_fifo.purpose: bounded ring-buffer of soapc_log (prevents disk fill)

process_lifecycle.daemon: soapc daemons via daemon(1,1); writes PID at /var/run/soapd.pid
